sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "oplog" ("op_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (origin_seq > 0), "wire_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (wire_version > 0), "hlc_wall_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (hlc_wall_ms >= 0), "hlc_counter" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (hlc_counter >= 0), "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (payload_schema_version > 0), "envelope_bytes" BLOB NOT NULL, "signature" BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(signature) = 64), "received_from_device_id" TEXT, "received_at_ms" INTEGER, "apply_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_entity_create' CHECK (apply_state IN ('applied', 'pending_entity_create', 'pending_dependency', 'pending_authorization', 'pending_schema', 'unauthorized_revoked', 'invalid_domain')), "retry_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "local_error" TEXT, UNIQUE(workspace_id, origin_device_id, origin_seq));
CREATE INDEX idx_oplog_origin ON oplog (workspace_id, origin_device_id, origin_seq)
CREATE INDEX idx_oplog_entity ON oplog (workspace_id, entity_type, entity_id)

CREATE TRIGGER oplog_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF op_id, workspace_id, origin_device_id, origin_seq, wire_version, hlc_wall_ms, hlc_counter, entity_type, entity_id, "action", payload_schema_version, envelope_bytes, signature ON oplog BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'Operation content is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER oplog_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON oplog BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'V1 retains all operations');END

CREATE TRIGGER oplog_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON oplog WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oplog WHERE op_id = NEW.op_id OR(workspace_id = NEW.workspace_id AND origin_device_id = NEW.origin_device_id AND origin_seq = NEW.origin_seq)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'Operation identity already exists');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workspace_clock_state" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_origin_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (next_origin_seq > 0), "last_hlc_wall_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (last_hlc_wall_ms >= 0), "last_hlc_counter" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (last_hlc_counter >= 0), PRIMARY KEY(workspace_id, device_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "observed_origins" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "max_observed_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (max_observed_seq >= 0), PRIMARY KEY(workspace_id, device_id, origin_device_id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_quarantine" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workspaces" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "stats_timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at_ms >= 0), "created_by_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trusted_devices" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "identity_public_key" BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(identity_public_key) = 32), "trust_state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trust_state IN ('active', 'pending', 'revoked')), "max_allowed_origin_seq" INTEGER CHECK (max_allowed_origin_seq >= 0), PRIMARY KEY(workspace_id, device_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exam_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES workspaces(id), "exam_name" TEXT, "exam_date" TEXT, "target_school" TEXT, "target_major" TEXT, "target_total_score_x100" INTEGER CHECK (target_total_score_x100 >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subjects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT, "target_score_x100" INTEGER CHECK (target_score_x100 >= 0), "max_score_x100" INTEGER CHECK (max_score_x100 >= 0), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (archived IN (0, 1)), UNIQUE(workspace_id, id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT, "knowledge_node_id" TEXT, "scheduled_date" TEXT, "due_at_ms" INTEGER CHECK (due_at_ms >= 0), "estimated_seconds" INTEGER CHECK (estimated_seconds >= 0), "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('todo', 'doing', 'completed', 'cancelled')), "completed_at_ms" INTEGER CHECK (completed_at_ms >= 0), "note" TEXT, UNIQUE(workspace_id, id), FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id, subject_id)REFERENCES subjects(workspace_id, id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_reviews" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id), "review_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(workspace_id, review_date));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "study_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id), "subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT, "knowledge_node_id" TEXT, "owner_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'paused', 'completed')), "started_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (started_at_ms >= 0), "ended_at_ms" INTEGER, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('stopwatch', 'pomodoro')), "note" TEXT, CHECK((status = 'completed' AND ended_at_ms IS NOT NULL AND ended_at_ms >= started_at_ms)OR(status <> 'completed' AND ended_at_ms IS NULL)), UNIQUE(workspace_id, id), FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id, subject_id)REFERENCES subjects(workspace_id, id), FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id, task_id)REFERENCES tasks(workspace_id, id), FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id, owner_device_id)REFERENCES trusted_devices(workspace_id, device_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "study_session_segments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (started_at_ms >= 0), "ended_at_ms" INTEGER CHECK (ended_at_ms >= started_at_ms), FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id, session_id)REFERENCES study_sessions(workspace_id, id));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_open_segment ON study_session_segments (workspace_id, session_id) WHERE ended_at_ms IS NULL
CREATE VIEW session_durations AS SELECT workspace_id, session_id, SUM(COALESCE(ended_at_ms - started_at_ms, 0)) AS duration_ms FROM study_session_segments GROUP BY workspace_id, session_id

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entity_field_clock" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "winner_op_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oplog(op_id), "hlc_wall_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "hlc_counter" INTEGER NOT NULL, "origin_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "value_bytes" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(workspace_id, entity_type, entity_id, field_name));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tombstones" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entity_type <> 'daily_review'), "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "delete_op_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oplog(op_id), "hlc_wall_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "hlc_counter" INTEGER NOT NULL, "origin_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(workspace_id, entity_type, entity_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "text_field_versions" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "op_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oplog(op_id), "origin_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_active = 1), PRIMARY KEY(workspace_id, entity_type, entity_id, field_name, op_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "materialization_state" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending_create', 'pending_dependency', 'materialized', 'deleted')), PRIMARY KEY(workspace_id, entity_type, entity_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "origin_progress" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "max_contiguous_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (max_contiguous_seq >= 0), PRIMARY KEY(workspace_id, origin_device_id));
